subject: gk
question: Criminal law amendment act 2018, increased minimum punishment for rape of women from 7 to _________ years.
solution: The correct answer is __**10.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **The Criminal Law Amendment Act 2018** was enacted in response to the increasing cases of sexual violence against women in India. • It has** increased the minimum punishment for rape of women from 7 to 10 years**. • The act also** introduced the death penalty as a possible punishment for the rape of girls under the age of 12** and increased the minimum punishment for gang rape and rape of a minor to 20 years and life imprisonment, respectively.
